zh.title: 土耳其航空計劃開航倫敦城市機場（LCY）但面臨機型挑戰
zh.summary: 土耳其航空規劃新增倫敦城市機場航線；現有客機暫無合適解決方案
body: 根據媒體 Simple Flying 於 2026 年 8 月 19 日的報導，土耳其航空目前正計劃新增往返倫敦城市機場的航線。然而，這項航線擴展計畫也引發了外界對於該航空公司未來將如何進行實際營運的討論。
報導指出，土耳其航空展現了增設倫敦城市機場航點的意圖。不過，在考量該航空公司目前的機隊配置時，其現有的客機中，沒有任何一款機能為這條新航線提供顯而易見的營運解決方案。這項規劃後續將如何克服機型適應性的挑戰，仍有待觀察。

en.title: Turkish Airlines Plans New Route to London City Airport (LCY)
en.summary: Turkish Airlines plans flights to London City despite lacking suitable current aircraft.
body: According to a report published by Simple Flying on August 19, 2026, the major carrier Turkish Airlines is currently planning to add flights to London City. This prospective expansion has raised questions regarding how the airline will operate the route.

The plans indicate a desire by Turkish Airlines to establish a presence at London City. However, based on the airline's existing fleet, none of its current aircraft offers an obvious solution for this route. It remains to be seen how the carrier will address this fleet challenge for the planned flights.
